messages.content: Analyze this URL: https://login-var-verify.example.com/path?ref=xn--vr-mia.com

{"url":"https://login-var-verify.example.com/path?ref=xn--vr-mia.com","registrableDomain":"example.com","punycodeRegistrableDomain":"example.com","path":"/path","query":{"ref":"xn--vr-mia.com"},"containsTargetName":true,"targetName":"var"}
The registrable domain is example.com — not xn--vr-mia.com. The name “var” appears only in a subdomain and query parameter, which is a common lookalike pattern.
